Pick any model. Hold out a calibration s.zh: 任选一个模型，留出一个校准集，计算残差，取其 (1−α) 分位数。由此得到的区间以至少 (1−α) 的概率包含真值。无需对分布作假设，也无需对模型作假设。实时回归演示证实了覆盖率；CQR 与 ACI 变体进一步把它推广到异方差数据与非可交换数据。
Pick any model. Hold out a calibration s.src:
Pick any model. Hold out a calibration set. Compute the
          residuals. Take their (1−α) quantile. The resulting
          interval contains the truth with probability at least
          (1−α). Distribution-free, model-free. Live regression
          demo confirms coverage; CQR and ACI variants extend it
          to heteroscedastic and non-exchangeable data.

@@T0@@~18 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Pro.zh:
@@T0@@约 18 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@概率 · 不确定性量化 · 校准@@T3@@

Most uncertainty methods give you \"a nu.zh: 大多数不确定性方法给你的只是「一个看起来像不确定性的数字」，却不保证它真的是。共形预测给出的是一个有限样本、免分布假设、免模型假设的@@T0@@覆盖率保证@@T1@@：在可交换数据上，区间以至少 $1 - \alpha$ 的概率包含真值。取 $\alpha = 0.1$，即可得到 90% 的区间。
Most uncertainty methods give you \"a nu.src: Most uncertainty methods give you "a number that looks like uncertainty" without any guarantee that it actually is. Conformal prediction gives a finite-sample, distribution-free, model-free coverage guarantee: the interval contains the true value with probability at least $1 - \alpha$ on exchangeable data. Pick $\alpha = 0.1$, get 90% intervals.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Trust.zh:
@@T0@@一句话口号。@@T1@@
          继续信任你那个使用既有损失 / 训练配方 / 超参数的点预测器。只需留出一个校准集，取残差的一个分位数，保证便是你的了。无需重新训练，无需新模型。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Trust.src: The slogan. Trust your point predictor with whatever loss / training recipe / hyperparameters you already use. Just hold out a calibration set, take a quantile of residuals, and the guarantee is yours. No retraining. No new model.

The simplest variant. Three sets: traini.zh: 最简单的变体。三个集合：训练集、校准集、测试集。在训练集上训练你偏爱的模型 $\hat f$。在校准集上计算非一致性得分 $s_i = |y_i - \hat f(x_i)|$。将它们排序。取第 $\lceil (1-\alpha)(n+1) \rceil / n$ 大的值作为 $\hat q$。对于任意新的 $x$，区间为 $[\hat f(x) - \hat q,\, \hat f(x) + \hat q]$。
The simplest variant. Three sets: traini.src:
The simplest variant. Three sets: training, calibration,
          test. Train your favourite model $\hat f$ on training. On
          calibration, compute nonconformity scores
          $s_i = |y_i - \hat f(x_i)|$. Sort them. Take the
          $\lceil (1-\alpha)(n+1) \rceil / n$-th largest as $\hat q$.
          For any new $x$, the interval is
          $[\hat f(x) - \hat q,\, \hat f(x) + \hat q]$.

Theorem (Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer; 2005):.zh: 定理（Vovk、Gammerman、Shafer；2005）：若校准数据与测试数据可交换，则该区间具有至少 $1 - \alpha$ 的边缘覆盖率。无需对模型作假设；无需对 $y$ 的分布作假设；除一个分位数之外别无所需。
Theorem (Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer; 2005):.src:
Theorem (Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer; 2005): if calibration and
          test data are exchangeable, this interval has marginal
          coverage at least $1 - \alpha$. No model assumptions; no
          distributional assumptions on $y$; nothing but a quantile.

Heteroscedastic 1-D regression: noise gr.zh: 异方差一维回归：噪声随 $|x|$ 增大。我们在训练集上拟合一个多项式回归器，在校准集上做共形化，并在一个大型测试集上报告经验覆盖率。拖动 $\alpha$ 与校准集大小，观察覆盖率条如何跟随目标。
Heteroscedastic 1-D regression: noise gr.src:
Heteroscedastic 1-D regression: noise grows with $|x|$. We
          fit a polynomial regressor on the training set, conformalise
          on a calibration set, and report empirical coverage on a
          large test set. Slide $\alpha$ and the calibration size and
          watch the coverage bar track the target.

@@T0@@target coverage @@T1@@90.0%@@T2@@@.src: target coverage 90.0% empirical coverage —

Black points: data. Solid blue: predicto.zh: 黑色点：数据。蓝色实线：预测器。青色带：共形区间。红点：落在带外的测试点（应占 α 的比例）。
Black points: data. Solid blue: predicto.src: Black points: data. Solid blue: predictor. Teal band: conformal interval. Red dots: test points outside the band (should be α fraction).

Empirical coverage across resamples (tar.zh: 多次重采样下的经验覆盖率（目标以虚线表示）。覆盖率应在无需任何模型假设的情况下跟随 1−α。
Empirical coverage across resamples (tar.src: Empirical coverage across resamples (target dashed). Coverage should track 1−α with no model assumptions.

Split conformal gives a constant-width i.zh: 分裂共形在处处都给出固定宽度的区间 —— 当噪声呈异方差时这是一种浪费。解决办法：在训练集上拟合两个分位数回归器 $\hat q_{\alpha/2}, \hat q_{1-\alpha/2}$；令校准得分为 $s_i = \max\{\hat q_{\alpha/2}(x_i) - y_i,\, y_i - \hat q_{1-\alpha/2}(x_i)\}$。取 $(1-\alpha)$ 分位数 $\hat q$。在 $x$ 处的区间为 $[\hat q_{\alpha/2}(x) - \hat q,\, \hat q_{1-\alpha/2}(x) + \hat q]$。
Split conformal gives a constant-width i.src:
Split conformal gives a constant-width interval everywhere
          — wasteful when noise is heteroscedastic. The fix:
          fit two quantile regressors $\hat q_{\alpha/2}, \hat
          q_{1-\alpha/2}$ on training; let
          $s_i = \max\{\hat q_{\alpha/2}(x_i) - y_i,\, y_i - \hat
          q_{1-\alpha/2}(x_i)\}$ be the calibration score. Take the
          $(1-\alpha)$ quantile $\hat q$. Interval at $x$ is
          $[\hat q_{\alpha/2}(x) - \hat q,\, \hat q_{1-\alpha/2}(x)
          + \hat q]$.

Coverage guarantee unchanged. Width adap.zh: 覆盖率保证不变，而宽度会随局部噪声自适应。在上方演示中切换 @@T0@@CQR@@T1@@，看这条带如何随数据「呼吸」。
Coverage guarantee unchanged. Width adap.src: Coverage guarantee unchanged. Width adapts to local noise. Toggle CQR in the demo above to see the band breathe with the data.

Time series + non-exchangeable data.zh: 时间序列与非可交换数据

The exchangeability assumption is broken.zh: 可交换性假设在时间序列中被打破：今天的分布依赖于昨天。两种实用的补救办法：
The exchangeability assumption is broken.src:
The exchangeability assumption is broken in time series:
          today's distribution depends on yesterday. Two practical
          fixes:

@@T0@@Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI;.zh: @@T0@@自适应共形推断（ACI；Gibbs & Candès，2021）。@@T1@@ 维护一个随近期未覆盖率而调整的运行值 $\alpha_t$：$\alpha_{t+1} = \alpha_t + \gamma\,(\alpha - \mathbb{1}\{y_t \notin C_t\})$。区间宽度随漂移而「呼吸」。
@@T0@@Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI;.src: Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI; Gibbs & Candès, 2021). Maintain a running $\alpha_t$ that adjusts based on recent miscoverage: $\alpha_{t+1} = \alpha_t + \gamma\,(\alpha - \mathbb{1}\{y_t \notin C_t\})$. The interval width breathes with the drift.

@@T0@@EnbPI / weighted conformal.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@EnbPI / 加权共形。@@T1@@ 把对残差的均匀经验累积分布函数替换为一个对较旧数据点衰减的加权版本。以牺牲部分边缘覆盖率换取自适应性。
@@T0@@EnbPI / weighted conformal.@@T1@@.src: EnbPI / weighted conformal. Replace the uniform empirical CDF over residuals with a weighted one that decays older points. Trades some marginal coverage for adaptivity.

Even outside time series, conformal can.zh: 即便不在时间序列场景中，当部署时遭遇协变量偏移，共形预测也可能丧失覆盖率。Mondrian / 类别条件共形按特征划分校准集，使保证对每一组分别成立。
Even outside time series, conformal can.src:
Even outside time series, conformal can lose coverage when
          covariate-shift hits at deployment. Mondrian / class-conditional
          conformal partitions the calibration set by feature so the
          guarantee holds per group.

Conformal classification — adaptive pred.zh: 共形分类 —— 自适应预测集

For classification, the conformal output.zh: 对于分类，共形的输出不是一个区间 —— 而是一个类别标签的@@T0@@集合@@T1@@。自适应预测集（APS；Romano 等，2020）对 softmax 概率排序，从高到低逐类加入，直到累积概率超过一个经过校准的阈值 $\hat q$。覆盖率保证：真实类别以至少 $1 - \alpha$ 的概率落在该集合中。
For classification, the conformal output.src: For classification, the conformal output isn't an interval — it's a set of class labels. Adaptive Prediction Sets (APS; Romano et al., 2020) sort the softmax probabilities and add classes from highest to lowest until the cumulative probability exceeds a calibrated threshold $\hat q$. Coverage guarantee: the true class is in the set with probability at least $1 - \alpha$.

Easy points get small sets (often just 1.zh: 容易的点得到小集合（往往只有 1 个类别）；含糊的点得到更大的集合。平均集合大小是衡量信息量的自然指标。
Easy points get small sets (often just 1.src:
Easy points get small sets (often just 1 class); ambiguous
          points get larger sets. Average set size is the natural
          informativeness measure.

@@T0@@target cov @@T1@@90.0%@@T2@@@@T3@@.src: target cov 90.0% empirical cov — avg set size —

Pool of test points colour-coded by pred.zh: 测试点集合以预测集大小进行颜色编码。容易区域：单元素集（最浅）。含糊的边界：2 类或 3 类的集合（较深）。拖动 α，观察集合如何收缩 / 扩张。
Pool of test points colour-coded by pred.src: Pool of test points colour-coded by predicted set size. Easy regions: singleton sets (lightest). Ambiguous boundaries: 2- or 3-class sets (darker). Slide α and watch sets shrink/grow.

@@T0@@What APS gets right.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@APS 的过人之处。@@T1@@
          集合大小随难易程度自适应。一个轻易即可分类的点得到单元素集；一个含糊的点得到所有可能的类别；一个混乱至极的点则得到完整的标签集。无论底层分类器的质量如何，边缘覆盖率都保证为 $1-\alpha$。
@@T0@@What APS gets right.@@T1@@\n.src: What APS gets right. Set size adapts to difficulty. A trivially-classified point gets a singleton; an ambiguous point gets all the plausible classes; a wildly-confused point gets the full label set. Marginal coverage is guaranteed at $1-\alpha$ regardless of the underlying classifier's quality.

Where conformal is the right tool.src: Where conformal is the right tool

@@T0@@Deployed predictor add-on.@@T1@@ W.zh: @@T0@@已部署预测器的附加组件。@@T1@@ 用分裂共形包裹任何现有模型：200 个校准点，一个分位数，即可上线 90% 区间。五行代码；无需重新训练。
@@T0@@Deployed predictor add-on.@@T1@@ W.src: Deployed predictor add-on. Wrap any existing model with split-conformal: 200 calibration points, one quantile, ship a 90% interval. Five lines of code; no retraining.

@@T0@@Forecasting.@@T1@@ Conformal-on-Pa.zh: @@T0@@预测。@@T1@@ 在 PatchTST 之上施加共形，可在任意预测步长上给出带覆盖率保证的区间预测——这比「我们用了贝叶斯神经网络」要强得多。
@@T0@@Forecasting.@@T1@@ Conformal-on-Pa.src: Forecasting. Conformal-on-PatchTST gives interval forecasts at any horizon with a coverage guarantee — a much stronger claim than "we used a Bayesian neural network".

@@T0@@Regression with calibrated uncerta.zh: @@T0@@带校准不确定性的回归。@@T1@@ 心率 / 呼吸 / 血糖估计配上经过校准的区间，才能使安全性的论断站得住脚。
@@T0@@Regression with calibrated uncerta.src: Regression with calibrated uncertainty. Heart-rate / respiration / blood-glucose estimates with calibrated intervals make safety claims realistic.

@@T0@@LLM hallucination control.@@T1@@ C.zh: @@T0@@LLM 幻觉控制。@@T1@@ 共形语言建模（Quach 等，2024）给出具有边缘覆盖率的候选续写集合——把一个自由形式的生成器转变为一个经过校准的集合预测器。
@@T0@@LLM hallucination control.@@T1@@ C.src: LLM hallucination control. Conformal language modelling (Quach et al., 2024) gives sets of candidate completions with marginal coverage — turning a free-form generator into a calibrated set predictor.

@@T0@@Multi-class classification with ab.zh: @@T0@@带拒识的多分类。@@T1@@ APS / RAPS 变体产生共形集合（类别标签的子集）。当集合很大时，模型即在拒识；应转交人工处理。
@@T0@@Multi-class classification with ab.src: Multi-class classification with abstention. APS / RAPS variants produce conformal sets (subsets of class labels). When the set is large, the model is abstaining; route to a human.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n C.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          共形预测是为任何已部署模型添加带保证的覆盖率区间的最廉价方式。它并不取代概率方法（贝叶斯、NP、GP），但它是包裹在这些方法之外的正确安全网——而且添加它的代价几乎为零。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n C.src: Final takeaway. Conformal prediction is the cheapest way to add a guaranteed coverage band to any deployed model. It doesn't replace probabilistic methods (Bayesian, NPs, GPs), but it's the right safety net to wrap around them — and it costs almost nothing to add.

The marginal-coverage theorem, with the.zh: 边缘覆盖率定理及其细则
The marginal-coverage theorem, with the.src: The marginal-coverage theorem, with the fine print

Split conformal's guarantee is precise:.zh: 分裂共形的保证是精确的：对任意非一致性得分 $s$、可交换的校准集以及未覆盖率 $\alpha$，有
Split conformal's guarantee is precise:.src: Split conformal's guarantee is precise: for any nonconformity score $s$, exchangeable calibration set, and miscoverage $\alpha$,

Three subtleties to understand:.zh: 需要理解的三点微妙之处：

@@T0@@\"Marginal\" not \"conditional\".@.zh: @@T0@@是「边缘」而非「条件」。@@T1@@ 保证是针对 $(X, Y)$ 的联合分布而言的，而非以 $X$ 为条件的。因此你在所有输入上平均得到 90% 的覆盖率，但并不在每一个子群上都得到 90% 的覆盖率。一个 90% 区间可能在困难输入上系统性地失准，而在容易输入上过度覆盖。
@@T0@@\"Marginal\" not \"conditional\".@.src: "Marginal" not "conditional". The guarantee is over the joint distribution of $(X, Y)$, not conditional on $X$. So you get 90% coverage averaged over inputs, but you don't get 90% coverage on every subgroup. A 90% interval can systematically miss on hard inputs and over-cover on easy ones.

@@T0@@The randomness is in the calibrati.zh: @@T0@@随机性来自校准集。@@T1@@ 给定一个固定的校准集，测试数据上的覆盖率是一个固定的数——可能高于也可能低于 $1 - \alpha$。定理所说的是：@@T2@@在多次抽取校准集后取平均@@T3@@，覆盖率才命中目标。
@@T0@@The randomness is in the calibrati.src: The randomness is in the calibration set. Given a fixed calibration set, the coverage on test data is a fixed number — possibly above or below $1 - \alpha$. The theorem says averaged over draws of the calibration set, coverage hits the target.

@@T0@@Exchangeability is the only assump.zh: @@T0@@可交换性是唯一的假设。@@T1@@ 校准数据与测试数据必须来自同一分布（事实上要求略弱——它们作为一个整体集合必须是可交换的）。不对模型作假设，不假设高斯噪声，不要求平滑性。
@@T0@@Exchangeability is the only assump.src: Exchangeability is the only assumption. Calibration and test data must come from the same distribution (in fact, slightly weaker — they must be exchangeable as a single set). No assumption on the model, no Gaussian noise, no smoothness.

When does this fail in practice?.src: When does this fail in practice?

@@T0@@Distribution shift.@@T1@@ Exchange.zh: @@T0@@分布偏移。@@T1@@ 可交换性被打破；覆盖率可能任意下降。如果你知道协变量偏移的权重，可使用@@T2@@加权共形@@T3@@（Tibshirani 等，2019）。
@@T0@@Distribution shift.@@T1@@ Exchange.src: Distribution shift. Exchangeability is broken; coverage can drop arbitrarily. Use weighted conformal (Tibshirani et al., 2019) if you know the covariate-shift weights.

@@T0@@Adversarial inputs.@@T1@@ Same pro.zh: @@T0@@对抗性输入。@@T1@@ 这是同一个问题从另一个角度的体现——对手特意选择了与校准集不同的输入。共形预测对此毫无防御能力。
@@T0@@Adversarial inputs.@@T1@@ Same pro.src: Adversarial inputs. Same problem from a different angle — the adversary has chosen the input to be unlike calibration. Conformal gives no defence.

@@T0@@Temporal drift.@@T1@@ If your cali.zh: @@T0@@时间漂移。@@T1@@ 如果你的校准集来自昨天而测试集来自今天，在线共形（ACI；Gibbs & Candès，2021）通过随时间调整阈值来维持覆盖率。
@@T0@@Temporal drift.@@T1@@ If your cali.src: Temporal drift. If your calibration set is from yesterday and your test set is from today, online conformal (ACI; Gibbs & Candès, 2021) maintains coverage by adapting the threshold over time.

The conformal recipe, step by step.src: The conformal recipe, step by step

@@T0@@Split.@@T1@@ Hold out a calibratio.zh: @@T0@@划分。@@T1@@ 留出一个大小为 $n$ 的校准集。典型的 $n = 500–2000$。$n$ 越大 → 区间越紧；二者关系为 $\sqrt{1/n}$。
@@T0@@Split.@@T1@@ Hold out a calibratio.src: Split. Hold out a calibration set of size $n$. Typical $n = 500–2000$. Larger $n$ → tighter intervals; the relationship is $\sqrt{1/n}$.

@@T0@@Score.@@T1@@ Define a nonconformit.zh: @@T0@@打分。@@T1@@ 定义一个非一致性得分 $s(x, y)$。回归情形：$|y - \hat\mu(x)|$（朴素版）；$|y - \hat\mu(x)| / \hat\sigma(x)$（归一化版）；$\max(\hat q_\alpha(x) - y, y - \hat q_{1-\alpha}(x))$（CQR）。分类情形：$1 - \hat p_y(x)$（朴素版）；累积秩得分（APS / RAPS）。
@@T0@@Score.@@T1@@ Define a nonconformit.src: Score. Define a nonconformity score $s(x, y)$. For regression: $|y - \hat\mu(x)|$ (vanilla); $|y - \hat\mu(x)| / \hat\sigma(x)$ (normalised); $\max(\hat q_\alpha(x) - y, y - \hat q_{1-\alpha}(x))$ (CQR). For classification: $1 - \hat p_y(x)$ (vanilla); cumulative-rank score (APS / RAPS).

@@T0@@Calibrate.@@T1@@ Compute $\\hat q$.zh: @@T0@@校准。@@T1@@ 计算 $\hat q$ = $\{s(x_i, y_i)\}_{i=1}^n$ 的第 $\lceil (n+1)(1-\alpha) \rceil / n$ 分位数。
@@T0@@Calibrate.@@T1@@ Compute $\\hat q$.src: Calibrate. Compute $\hat q$ = the $\lceil (n+1)(1-\alpha) \rceil / n$ quantile of $\{s(x_i, y_i)\}_{i=1}^n$.

@@T0@@Evaluate.@@T1@@ On a held-out test.zh: @@T0@@评估。@@T1@@ 在留出的测试集上检查：(a) 经验覆盖率 ≈ $1 - \alpha$；(b) 平均集合大小或区间宽度（信息量）；(c) 在重要子群上的条件覆盖率。
@@T0@@Evaluate.@@T1@@ On a held-out test.src: Evaluate. On a held-out test set, check (a) empirical coverage ≈ $1 - \alpha$, (b) average set size or interval width (informativeness), (c) conditional coverage on important subgroups.

@@T0@@The score is the design knob.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@得分函数就是那个可调节的设计旋钮。@@T1@@
          对任何得分而言，边缘覆盖率都是自动成立的。而@@T2@@紧致@@T3@@的区间则要求得分能随预测难度伸缩——这正是 CQR（用于回归）与 APS（用于分类）优于朴素的绝对残差 / 一减 softmax 得分的原因。
@@T0@@The score is the design knob.@@T1@.src: The score is the design knob. Marginal coverage is automatic for any score. Tight intervals require a score that scales with prediction difficulty — that's why CQR (for regression) and APS (for classification) outperform the vanilla absolute-residual / one-minus-softmax scores.

@@T0@@Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer (2005)@@T1.zh: @@T0@@Vovk、Gammerman、Shafer（2005）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@Algorithmic Learning in a Random World.@@T3@@ 关于共形预测的奠基性著作。
@@T0@@Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer (2005)@@T1.src: Vovk, Gammerman, Shafer (2005) — Algorithmic Learning in a Random World. The original book on conformal prediction.

@@T0@@Lei, Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani, Wa.zh: @@T0@@Lei、Sell、Rinaldo、Tibshirani、Wasserman（2018）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@Distribution-Free Predictive Inference for Regression.@@T3@@ 分裂共形回归论文。
@@T0@@Lei, Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani, Wa.src: Lei, Sell, Rinaldo, Tibshirani, Wasserman (2018) — Distribution-Free Predictive Inference for Regression. The split-conformal regression paper.

@@T0@@Romano, Sesia, Candès (2020)@@T1@@.src: Romano, Sesia, Candès (2020) — Classification with Valid and Adaptive Coverage (APS).

@@T0@@Angelopoulos, Bates (2021)@@T1@@ &.zh: @@T0@@Angelopoulos、Bates（2021）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification.@@T3@@ 最易读的现代入门读物。
@@T0@@Angelopoulos, Bates (2021)@@T1@@ &.src: Angelopoulos, Bates (2021) — A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification. The most readable modern intro.

@@T0@@Gibbs &amp; Candès (2021)@@T1@@ &m.zh: @@T0@@Gibbs & Candès（2021）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@Adaptive Conformal Inference.@@T3@@ 面向非平稳数据的在线共形方法。
@@T0@@Gibbs &amp; Candès (2021)@@T1@@ &m.src: Gibbs & Candès (2021) — Adaptive Conformal Inference. Online conformal for non-stationary data.

meta.title: 动手实现共形预测
meta.tagline: 带覆盖率保证的预测区间——无需假设，只差一个分位数
meta.summary: 任选一个模型，留出一个校准集，计算残差，取其 (1−α) 分位数。由此得到的区间以至少 (1−α) 的概率包含真值——免分布假设、免模型假设。实时回归与分类演示在合成数据上证实了覆盖率，随后我们逐一走过自适应变体（CQR）与适合时间序列的变体（ACI）。
highlights: 在合成一维数据集上实时运行的裂共形回归；可切换校准集大小与目标覆盖率。
覆盖率诊断：一个应始终在 1−α 附近徘徊的经验覆盖率条，与底层模型无关。
CQR（共形化分位数回归）——在保持相同覆盖率保证的同时获得自适应宽度。
面向非可交换数据的时间序列 ACI（自适应共形推断）。
